name: Software Project Generator
description: An advanced recipe that orchestrates complete project initialization (frontend, backend, full-stack, CLI, API) with intelligent framework detection, dependency management, code quality setup, and comprehensive documentation generation

environment_variables.name: PROJECT_NAME
environment_variables.description: Name of the project to initialize (alphanumeric and dashes only)

environment_variables.name: FRONTEND_FRAMEWORK
environment_variables.description: Frontend framework to use (react, vue, svelte, nextjs, none)

environment_variables.name: BACKEND_FRAMEWORK
environment_variables.description: Backend framework to use (nodejs, python-fastapi, go, rust-actix, none)

environment_variables.name: DATABASE
environment_variables.description: Database to integrate (postgresql, mongodb, mysql, sqlite, none)

environment_variables.name: INCLUDE_TESTING
environment_variables.description: Whether to include testing setup with unit and integration tests (true/false)

environment_variables.name: BASE_DIRECTORY
environment_variables.description: Base directory where the project should be created
